questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "ADVERSE"
questions.explanation: ADVERSE का अर्थ होता है प्रतिकूल, विपरीत या अहितकर। Synonym: Unfavorable, Hostile, Harmful.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "ADVERSE"
questions.explanation: ADVERSE (प्रतिकूल) का Antonym है Favorable (अनुकूल) या Beneficial.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "BENEVOLENT"
questions.explanation: BENEVOLENT का अर्थ होता है परोपकारी, दयालु या उदार। Synonym: Generous, Altruistic, Kind.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "BENEVOLENT"
questions.explanation: BENEVOLENT (उदार/दयालु) का Antonym है Malevolent (द्वेषी) या Miserly.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "CALLOUS"
questions.explanation: CALLOUS का अर्थ होता है कठोर, संवेदनशील न होना या निर्दयी। Synonym: Insensitive, Unfeeling, Hardened.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "CALLOUS"
questions.explanation: CALLOUS (निर्दयी/कठोर) का Antonym है Sensitive (संवेदनशील) या Compassionate.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "DEVIOUS"
questions.explanation: DEVIOUS का अर्थ होता है चालाक, कपटी या घुमावदार। Synonym: Deceitful, Cunning, Dishonest.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "DEVIOUS"
questions.explanation: DEVIOUS (कपटी/चालाक) का Antonym है Honest (ईमानदार) या Straightforward.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A place or establishment where milk is stored and processed into butter or cheese"
questions.explanation: दुग्ध प्रसंस्करण केंद्र को Creamery या Dairy कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "An extreme or morbid fear of water"
questions.explanation: पानी से अत्यधिक भय को Hydrophobia कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "An extreme, irrational fear of spiders"
questions.explanation: मकड़ियों से अत्यधिक डर को Arachnophobia कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "An extreme or irrational fear of dogs"
questions.explanation: कुत्तों से अत्यधिक डर को Cynophobia कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "At the drop of a hat"
options: Instantly / without any delay or hesitation
questions.explanation: At the drop of a hat = बिना किसी हिचकिचाहट के, तुरंत।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Barking up the wrong tree"
options: Pursuing a wrong course of action or accusing wrong person
Barking at a dog under tree
questions.explanation: Barking up the wrong tree = गलत दिशा या गलत व्यक्ति पर प्रयास करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Bite off more than you can chew"
options: Take on a task that is too big for one's capacity
questions.explanation: Bite off more than you can chew = क्षमता से अधिक काम हाथ में लेना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Burn the candle at both ends"
options: Work tirelessly late at night and early morning
questions.explanation: Burn the candle at both ends = दिन-रात अत्यधिक परिश्रम करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Cry over spilt milk"
options: Regret or complain about something in past that cannot be undone
questions.explanation: Cry over spilt milk = जो हो गया उस पर व्यर्थ में पछताना।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "He is one of the most intelligent boy in our class."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'One of the' के बाद Plural Noun ('boys') का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "Neither Ram nor his brothers was invited to the party."
questions.explanation: Rule: Neither...nor में निकटतम सब्जेक्ट ('brothers' प्लुरल) के अनुसार Plural Verb 'were' आएगी।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "She has been waiting here since ten minutes."
questions.explanation: Rule: समय की अवधि ('ten minutes') के लिए प्रपोजिशन 'for' आता है (for ten minutes).

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "He was accused _____ stealing the gold watch."
questions.explanation: Rule: Verb 'Accuse' के साथ हमेशा 'of' आता है (accused of stealing).

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "She prefers tea _____ coffee in winter."
questions.explanation: Rule: Verb 'Prefer' के साथ प्रपोजिशन 'to' आता है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "The police are searching _____ the missing child."
questions.explanation: Rule: किसी खोई हुई वस्तु/व्यक्ति को खोजने के लिए 'search for' प्रयुक्त होता है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "GULLIBLE"

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who collects or is interested in postage stamps"
questions.explanation: डाक टिकट संग्रही को Philatelist कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who collects or studies coins and currency"
questions.explanation: सिक्कों के संग्रहकर्ता को Numismatist कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who loves, collects or reads books with passion"
questions.explanation: पुस्तक प्रेमी को Bibliophile कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "One who is present everywhere at the same time"

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Costs an arm and a leg"
questions.explanation: Costs an arm and a leg = अत्यधिक महँगा होना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Every cloud has a silver lining"
options: There is something good in every bad or difficult situation
questions.explanation: Every cloud has a silver lining = निराशा में भी आशा की किरण छिपी होती है।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Get out of hand"
questions.explanation: Get out of hand = नियंत्रण से बाहर होना।

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "No sooner had I reached <u>when</u> the train left."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'No sooner' के साथ कंजंक्शन 'than' आता है ('when' गलत है).

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "If I <u>was</u> a king, I would help all."
questions.explanation: Rule: काल्पनिक वाक्य में Subject के साथ हमेशा 'were' आता है।

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "She has completed the work."
options: The work had been completed by her.
The work was completed by her.
The work has been completed by her.
The work is completed by her.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect का Passive = Object + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject.

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "Close the door."
options: You are requested to close door.
questions.explanation: Imperative sentence का Passive = Let + Object + be + V3.

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: He said to me, "Where are you going?"
options: He asked me where I was going.
He asked me that where I was going.
He asked me where was I going.
He told me where I am going.
questions.explanation: WH- question का Indirect = asked + me + where + I + was going.

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: The teacher said, "The earth is round."
options: The teacher said that the earth is round.
The teacher said that the earth was round.
The teacher said that earth revolved.
The teacher told that earth is round.
questions.explanation: Universal truth वाक्यों का Tense Indirect Speech में परिवर्तित नहीं होता।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "LUCID"
questions.explanation: LUCID (स्पष्ट) का Antonym है Vague (अस्पष्ट) या Obscure.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A medicine or substance given to counteract the effects of a poison"
questions.explanation: विष काट की दवा को Antidote कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A word, law or custom that is no longer in active general use"

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "Food or water fit to be eaten or consumed safely"
